qualifications.finding: These exact questions retain source-present replies through answer/qualification edges and final reconciliation. Historical none is an answer-inventory consistency risk, not proof of absent source answers. Do not auto-relabel or certify complete choices.

Reader makes local need conditions explicit for selected baraita atoms. Producer quoted-baraita records retain empty condition arrays but final reconciliation and question context carry the need distinctions. Substance is represented; isolated extraction of the quoted clauses without linked reconciliation would overgeneralize. Restrict downstream use to contextual bundles; no unrestricted rule admission.

Producer lists Rabbi Yohanan/Rav Ashi as the pair but explicitly disclaims assigning which accepts. Reader anonymous summary and contextual suggestion are supported alternatives. No named distribution is certified.

Rejected status applies to the proposed interpretation of all, not to the road/mikveh duties; producer scope explicitly says so. The challenged Rav Ashi argument is accepted at5a:12. Do not treat local-stage enum alone as final rejection of the proposition.

The no-public-need restriction is only part of the answer to the challenge about needed public works. Read it together with repair_clear/repair_public and5a:7; it is not a competing answer allowing a need case to be called no-need. Reader compound inventory is supported but not an exclusive choice set.

semantic_assessment: All56 core source-derived claims compared, including repeated Shmuel reports with Zeira/Rabbah bar Yirmeya transmission, Babylonian-lake qualification, Rav Pappa/Rav Ashi distinction, continued drip and original-spring requirements.
4a:13 does not name which explanation accepts. Both sides preserve uncertainty rather than assigning by order. Rav Ashi and Ravina are not Rav himself.
Vegetable מדלין is initially lexical.4b:1–2 resolves thinning proposal through explicit water wording and concession; source-reader forward clarification is supported.

Public/private works distinguished by need; initial baraita phrases are reconciled at5a:7–8. Printed חוטטין לתוכן is retained without silently replacing it with חופרין or conflating it with חוטטין אותן.
The maintenance duties at5a:10 are source-present despite rejection of their proposed role as the extra meaning of all.5a:12 accepts the excavation inference; full continuation checked.

Rabbi and Rabbi Yehuda differ in derivation; Abaye/Rava supply exegetical versus discretionary-delay explanations. Bodily and nonbodily impurity conditions and counterfactual verse arguments are preserved.

8a:8–11 rejects initial eyesight derivation for night exclusion, accepts its use for one-eyed exclusion and replaces the night derivation with visible-to-me/not-my-lamp. No final ruling beyond local argument inferred.
Seven independent questions and23 relations checked against exact wording, conditions and continuation. Partial/none does not certify exhaustive mutually comparable alternatives.
No other source-only reading or graves receipt grants coverage automatically. Prior comparison files used solely to deduplicate coordinates.
